policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA destination guidance expressly records visa-free short visits for these Italian travellers.
conditions: XK, BA, PA and TN: visitor stays up to 90 days under the stated Italian MFA destination guidance.

BA requires a travel document valid at least three months beyond the planned stay; TN requires a passport from 1 January 2025. This excludes work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance states Cuba exclusively issues electronic visas and requires the visa before an Italian traveller departs.
conditions: The electronic visa is required before departure. A tour operator, the EVISA platform, Cuban consular offices or authorised agencies can arrange it.
The D'VIAJEROS form is separate from the visa. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic visa platform
steps: Arrange the electronic visitor visa before departure using the ordinary Italian passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'VIAJEROS arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: federal Iraq electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance requires ordinary EU passports, including Italian ordinary passports, to obtain the federal-Iraq visitor visa exclusively through its designated portal.
conditions: This covers federal Iraq, excluding the Kurdistan Region. Since 2 March 2025, ordinary passport holders of EU countries obtain the visa exclusively through the designated portal, not at an airport.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Federal Iraq electronic visa portal
steps: For federal Iraq, submit the ordinary Italian passport visitor application through the designated portal before travel.
Do not rely on an airport visa-on-arrival route.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA destination guidance expressly identifies these border-issued visitor visa routes for Italian ordinary passports.
conditions: KM: apply directly at arrival in the airport and collect the visa from local immigration offices; approximately EUR30 for one month. KH: short tourist visas can be obtained on arrival at international airports; an optional pre-departure online route also exists.

CI: before departure, obtain the D.S.T.-approved e-mail authorisation and carry the approved pre-registration, passport, yellow-fever certificate and payment receipt; biometric registration and visa printing/issuance occur at Abidjan airport. TM: a local tourist agency invitation and State Migration Service entry authorisation must be positively completed before a visa is issued at the airport or border. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Côte d'Ivoire evisa, but Italy MFA states that the traveller must first receive D.S.T. e-mail authorisation and the visa is then printed and issued at Abidjan airport. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance.

The fallback labels Turkmenistan advance visa required, but Italy MFA states that after invitation and entry authorisation the visa can be issued at the airport or border. This is a preapproved arrival-issuance route.
